purpose: Matched optional context-hook comparison; observational, not a quality/default gate

protocol.refresh: disabled in both arms; isolate context switch only; hints describe published/pre-refresh evidence
protocol.scope: matched multi-file dependency questions, not broad quality/performance claim
protocol.fixture_gate: seeded defects fail; upstream reference fixes pass before any agent trials
protocol.delivery_metric: official client hook_additional_context attachments; local protocol fixture additionally verifies exact hints enter actual model requests
protocol.measurement_wrapper: preserves actual registered entrypoint input/output; 850ms budget measures entrypoint call, wrapper overhead is outside it
protocol.negative_smoke: early missing executable stubs invalidated setup; bundle install --local now regenerates stubs while asserting unchanged lock

analysis_revision.reason: Reviewer identified aggregate would crash on retained invalid setup/model output. Catch per-trial analysis failures and retain original result metadata plus explicit analysis_error. No source, prompts, run conditions, trials or metric formulas changed.

measurement_limits: Two public Rails tasks with two repetitions per condition; no general improvement claim.
Both arms use full MCP evidence and lexical retrieval; refresh disabled to isolate context.
Actual official-client usage is separate from cl100k representation size. List-price estimates are not billed charges.
Two concurrent trials; agent wall is descriptive, not isolated Woods latency.
Callbacks were instrumented by a wrapper preserving entrypoint input/output. Native plugin registration was separately exercised against captured model requests.
The tracked-only diff.patch omits newly created untracked tests. Their native Write/Edit operations and test runs remain in retained transcripts; reconstructed test artifacts are labelled separately.
The source freshness check reported unverified_consumption_scopes before editing. Pre-refresh/unknown/drifted and truncation notices remain explicit.
All attempts and failed probes retained; early smoke setup lacked newly added executable stubs and was invalidated before primary trials.
All 16 emitted context hints appeared as official-client hook_additional_context attachments; this is not proof the model used each hint.

quality_review.observation: Core owners were commonly already inspected. Atomic-import repetition 1 prompted an extra DemoContent check that found nothing; broad transitive hints can add redundant work. New test paths received honest unresolved notices.
